title: TensorPlate ModelSpec
description: Model identity, model class, and backend-selection metadata. Mirrors include/tensorplate/core/model_spec.hpp::ModelSpec.

model_id.description: Stable identifier for the deployed model.

model_class.description: Model-class taxonomy. v0.1.0 validates only `vision` and `vla`; the remaining values are reserved for forward compatibility (bundle format).

artifact_path.description: Path to the loadable model artifact within the bundle (engine, state dict, .xmodel, ...).

backend_hint.description: Bundle-author declaration of the execution backend (e.g., `tensorrt`, `libtorch`, `python_pytorch`). The runtime validates availability and rejects unknown hints with the typed `unsupported` error; it never falls back heuristically.

precision_hint.description: Numeric precision profile. Backends that cannot honor the hint return `unsupported` rather than silently downgrading.

profile_id.description: Optional opaque identifier referencing a vendor-specific tuning profile inside the bundle.
